name: Tan & Curl
hours: Mon 7 AM–6 PM; Tue 7 AM–6 PM; Wed Closed; Thu 7 AM–6 PM; Fri 7 AM–6 PM; Sat Closed; Sun Closed

reviews.t: I must say this is by far the cleanest, most upscale salon I have been to. They are pricey but the amenities are; Alexa (that actually works) and plays what you want while you're tanning, big rooms, nice beds, the decor makes you feel like youre in a fantasy land it's so gorgeous. The gym is ok. Linda, the owner? Was very nice and showed us around, and while you're tanning you have fans all over your body. I honestly could have laid there longer. I wasnt hot. The fans were at my head, feet and in the bed. It was pleasant. I didnt want it to end. I'll definitely be returning and giving tan and curl my membership. I currently tan at a big gym/tan place in marion.
Linda, the owner, is a gifted stylist, caring friend and is always looking for new products to help her customers. She listens and does what you ask. Charming setting!
Linda is a wonderful lady! Very helpful and have a variety of services from hair to tanning to exercise machines. I would highly recommend this place!
Linda does an AMAZING job making my hair look Beautiful! Her prices are more than reasonable and she is a Sweetheart!

My wife loves to tan there. I love sitting in the parking lot listening to the birds and watching the squirrels while she tans. I love sitting in the parking lot listening to the birds and watching the squirrels while she tans
Linda does a great job. Very professional and clean operation by an experienced hair stylist.
The owner is a pleasant helpful lady. The exercise area is well equipt with a variety of machines and exceptionally well decorated. I'd recommend it.
Owner is very experienced and knowledgeable hair dresser. She gave me an excellent perm & was fast at rolling hair.
Linda does a great job with haircuts & perms. She listens to what you want.
Linda is the best! She has cut my hair for years.
